s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Every nonzero, non-8 object moves horizontally to the right edge of its row-space.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    z=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]]==v:
                        seen.add(z); q.append(z)
            comps.append((v,cells))
    # preserve relative positions and pack each component rightwards independently, skipping 8 markers
    for v,cells in sorted(comps,key=lambda a:max(c for r,c in a[1]),reverse=True):
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=0
        shift=0
        while True:
            nxt=[(r,c+shift+1) for r,c in cells]
            if any(c>=w or out[r][c]!=0 for r,c in nxt): break
            shift+=1
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift]=v
    return out
